successCriteria.description: BalanceService accepts IUnitOfWork as a new constructor dependency (in addition to IBalanceRepository, IEmployeeService, IPolicyService) and stores it for use in openPeriod/carryForward.

openPeriod performs its employee lookup, policy lookup, duplicate-key check, and balance create inside a single unitOfWork.withTransaction callback, forwarding the transaction's PoolClient as the optional last argument to every IBalanceRepository call it makes.

carryForward performs its source lookup, policy lookup, next-period lookup, and the resulting create/update inside a single unitOfWork.withTransaction callback, forwarding the transaction's PoolClient as the optional last argument to every IBalanceRepository call it makes.
getBalance and getBalanceById remain read-only and do NOT open a transaction or forward a client (they continue to call the repository without a client argument).

All existing BalanceService unit tests in tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.service.test.ts pass after the constructor change, with the four BalanceService constructions updated to pass a fake IUnitOfWork as the fourth argument.
A unit test verifies that when withTransaction's callback throws, the error propagates to the caller of openPeriod/carryForward (the service does not swallow or convert the transaction failure).

constraints: BalanceService must never import the pg Pool/PoolClient or the shared db connection directly; it obtains the client only from the injected IUnitOfWork.withTransaction callback.
withTransaction must be invoked only in BalanceService (the service owns the unit of work); it must NOT be added to IBalanceRepository or PgLeaveBalanceRepository.
No changes to IBalanceRepository or PgLeaveBalanceRepository are required — their methods already accept an optional trailing PoolClient and fall back to the shared pool when omitted.
IEmployeeService.getEmployeeById and IPolicyService.getPolicyByLeaveTypeCode remain unchanged and do NOT accept a client; they are read-only cross-module lookups.

The existing validation, error, and business-rule semantics of openPeriod/carryForward (full entitlement grant, min(unused, carryForwardDays) cap, ValidationError/NotFoundError/ConflictError) must be preserved unchanged — this phase only adds the transaction boundary.
outOfScope: No production DI/wiring changes — no DI container or wiring file in src/ instantiates BalanceService; only the unit test file constructs it.
No repository changes — IBalanceRepository/PgLeaveBalanceRepository already support client forwarding and are not modified.
No changes to IEmployeeService or IPolicyService — they do not gain a client parameter and are not required to join the transaction.
No audit-log writes (GP-002), routes/controllers, or RBAC for the balance module — those remain deferred to later phases.

entityInvariants.invariant: openPeriod and carryForward each execute their state-changing work atomically: either all repository writes within the operation succeed together or none are persisted (the injected IUnitOfWork.withTransaction provides this all-or-nothing boundary).
getBalance and getBalanceById are pure read-only operations that never open a transaction and never mutate balance state.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Preserves existing error semantics: ValidationError(400) for invalid input/non-positive entitlement, NotFoundError(404) for unknown employee/policy, ConflictError(409) for a duplicate balance key. A transaction failure propagates to the caller unchanged.

Preserves existing error semantics: ValidationError(400) for invalid sourceBalanceId / non-closable period / negative counters, NotFoundError(404) for missing source balance. A transaction failure propagates to the caller unchanged.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: BalanceService must obtain the transaction boundary exclusively through the IUnitOfWork.withTransaction contract (service owns the unit of work, data-access layer opens it), never importing the pool/client directly.

BalanceService must forward the transaction's PoolClient as the optional last argument to IBalanceRepository.create/findById/findByKey/update, matching the existing optional-client signatures (which fall back to the shared pool when omitted).

The transaction-boundary pattern must match AGENTS.md item 5: withTransaction is placed in the service (not the repository), and participating repository/service methods take the client as an optional last parameter.

integrationPoints.why: BalanceService injects IUnitOfWork and calls withTransaction to own the atomic boundary for openPeriod/carryForward.
BalanceService forwards the transaction's PoolClient to create/findById/findByKey/update so balance writes join the transaction.
Read-only cross-module lookups used by openPeriod/carryForward; unchanged and do not accept a client.
